name: PolicyNote
description:
Use the PolicyNote to access structured policy and regulatory intelligence from around the world. Search legislation, regulatory actions, policy updates, and government activity across jurisdictions.
The connector enables developers, analysts, and policy professionals to retrieve policy data programmatically and integrate it into internal tools, research workflows, dashboards, or monitoring systems. Queries return structured information about policy developments, government sources, and regulatory changes.
PolicyNote helps teams track public policy activity, build alerts, power analysis tools, and integrate government intelligence into their applications.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PolicyNote to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PolicyNote to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.policynote.com/v0/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PolicyNote MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PolicyNote lists 33 MCP tools, including curate_full_text, curate_locations, curate_snippets, curate_topics, get_action_types, get_actions_by_id, get_active_sessions, get_cq_document, get_elections_by_id, get_issues, get_legislation_analytics, and get_legislation_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PolicyNote?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PolicyNote in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PolicyNote requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PolicyNote is developed by FiscalNote. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
